title: So uncomfortable, it's painful
text: So uncomfortable, it's painful. I got two of the XL versions for me and my husband because we like to watch TV in bed at night and wanted to be comfortable and well supported. These never worked out right. They never settled well, so there is a complete lack of back support. We have only used them three times and they are far from comfortable. It's a real shame because I thought it was going to make us feel more comfortable. All I know is the pain in my lower and upper back has only gotten worse.
